definitions: To become overly excited or enthusiastic about something, often to the point of losing self-control or judgment.
To be so strongly affected by an emotion or idea that one acts impulsively or without proper consideration.
examples: Don't get carried away with the excitement of the moment.
She was carried away with her success and made some rash decisions.
He tends to carry himself away with his own ideas.
They were carried away with the music and started dancing wildly.
